name: Penpot
tagline: Penpot is the first open-source design and prototyping platform targeted at cross-functional teams. As a self-hosted or cloud alternative to Figma, it uses web standards (SVG) and offers AI features including component generation and design annotation. Its open-source nature makes it popular with privacy-conscious organisations.
